subject.title: [Feature]: Add Antigravity CLI (agy) as CLI backend to replace deprecated google-gemini-cli

question: Should OpenClaw ship and maintain an `agy`-backed Google CLI runtime in the bundled Google plugin, or require this preview/provider-specific integration to be distributed externally through the existing plugin surface?
rationale: The open candidate has real delegated-inference proof, but repository policy makes provider identity, credential ownership, setup, session behavior, and fallback handling compatibility-sensitive; only maintainers can choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled Google-plugin integration
options.body: Review and rebase the linked implementation, requiring current-head upgrade and setup proof plus aligned documentation before merge.

options.title: Route it to an external plugin
options.body: Decline bundled ownership and publish the required plugin/SDK contract and installation guidance for an independently maintained `agy` provider.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bundled Google-plugin integration
recommendation.body: Review and rebase the linked implementation, requiring current-head upgrade and setup proof plus aligned documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Kirchlive owns the only open, proof-positive implementation candidate and can clarify its intended Google-plugin boundary for maintainer review.
